summary: Frontend-only verification of the round-2 fix for the GitHub connect fresh-install isolation bug (reconfigure-one-org leaking siblings). Ran all 4 vitest tests in useGitHubConnectStatus.freshIsolation.test.js plus adjacent regression suites (repoSyncLag, claimFallback, NewUserWizard.connectRefinement) = 15/15 pass. Verified autoComplete='off' is present on both wizard-repo-input and wizard-branch-input in NewUserWizard.jsx (lines 1043, 1052). Live E2E via GitHub SSO round-trip was NOT feasible in the sandbox (real GitHub popup can't complete), same limitation as round 1 — relying on unit coverage as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix logic in useGitHubConnectStatus.js (lines 198-204) is correct: preConnectIdsRef is a Map(id -> repoCount) snapshotted at startConnect(); newOrChangedIds filters current ids where either (a) id is not in snapshot (brand new install) OR (b) current repo count != snapshotted repo count. An untouched sibling org (same id, same repo count) is correctly NOT marked fresh.

New test t_reconfiguring_one_existing_org_does_not_leak_other_unrelated_orgs is meaningful (not tautological): it seeds TWO pre-existing installs (auravw id=10 with 1 repo, VeroCapper id=20 with 1 repo), triggers startConnect(), then resolves the poll with auravw grown to 2 repos and VeroCapper byte-for-byte unchanged. Asserts freshInstallIds === ['10'] and explicitly not-contains '20'. Would fail under the round-1 fallback (which marked ALL currently-active as fresh when no new id appeared).

Minor observation: the poll-success `.find(...)` inside `.filter(...)` (line 202) is O(n^2) on installation count. Acceptable at n<=50 orgs which is realistic; noting for future micro-refactor if a user ever has hundreds of GitHub App installations.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Round-2 fix for freshInstallIds leak (reconfiguring one existing org used to promote all pre-existing installs to 'fresh'). Fix: snapshot repo COUNT per id (Map) in preConnectIdsRef, mark fresh only if id is new OR repo count changed. All 4 freshIsolation tests + 11 adjacent tests pass. autoComplete='off' verified on wizard-repo-input/wizard-branch-input inputs. Live GitHub OAuth E2E remains infeasible in sandbox.
rca of the issue: Round 1 poll-diff fallback (invoked when GitHub's postMessage doesn't arrive — common for reconfigure-existing-org since no new installation_id is minted) treated 'no new id' as 'mark all currently-active installations fresh'. On an account with multiple prior installs, this promoted every unrelated sibling org (e.g. VeroCapper) into freshInstallIds when the user only reconfigured one org (e.g. auravw). Round-2 fix snapshots per-installation repo-count in a Map before startConnect(), and post-poll only marks an installation fresh if its id is brand-new OR its repo grant count changed vs snapshot. Untouched siblings retain matching count → never marked fresh. Verified by the new regression-lock test.
